market_outlook.short_term: Elevated volatility. Fed hike under Warsh creates near-term headwinds; Hormuz energy shock keeps inflation sticky; Q4 seasonality (34/41 S&P gains) provides floor. Expect 3-5% range-bound trading with sector rotation from chips to cybersecurity/energy. Midterm election noise adds political risk premium.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains structurally intact (Anthropic $100B, ASML/TSMC expansion) but bifurcates winners. Energy security reshapes global trade. US debt trajectory is the primary macro risk. Buffett succession may shift market leadership toward next-gen value managers. India/Hyderabad and Africa (Dangote) offer emerging growth diversification.
